title: Care for each other. Grow together.
subtitle: Winners Chapel HOME GROUPS.
description: The Winners' Satellite Fellowship (WSF) is the share and care center for the Winners family. It is the home church where all Winners gather for a time of spiritual refreshing outside the church environment.
bibleVerse: Everyday they continued to meet together in the temple courts. They broke bread in their homes and ate together with glad and sincere hearts. — Acts 2:46
registrationContact: Contact the church to register your location as a WSF center.

uiText.ctaHeading: You were meant to enjoy a life free in Christ.
uiText.ctaSubheading: Take your first step towards it.
uiText.ctaDescription: We exist to bring God's freedom to everyone. We love to care for people who have been hurt. This is our mandate.
